title: Anaplan connector (Beta)
body:
The Anaplan connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the **Previews** page.

The connector ingests audit trail events and user account records from your Anaplan tenant into Databricks. Authentication uses an Anaplan CA certificate and its paired private key.

See [Anaplan connector](/aws/en/ingestion/lakeflow-connect/anaplan).
